description: Zooming out from 7 to 5 replaces the z7 tile with its z5 grandparent in one update, with no z6 tile in between. 'Kept' is in the tiles of either zoom and is visible before the zoom. 'Rival' is only in the new tile, overlaps 'Kept' and it appears first in the source while sharing the same tile, so it is placed first when neither label was visible before. 'Kept' continues its visible state from the old tile, which ranks it above 'Rival', so only 'Kept' is drawn. If the state were lost, only 'Rival' would be drawn.

skip-test.reason: bug: Kept looses state during z7->z0 transfer because of mismatched coordinates due to unstable point rounding behavior in geojson-vt - MAPSNAT-4366
